plivo agent — manage AI agents (PHLO flows) from the command line.

Requires a Contacto session: run 'plivo contacto login' first.

These commands hit the same regional Contacto API gateway the web console uses,
so anything they do is visible immediately in the dev console UI.

The attach subcommand uses your Plivo classic credentials (PLIVO_AUTH_ID +
PLIVO_AUTH_TOKEN) against api.plivo.com to rewire an application's answer URL —
that's a public Plivo REST operation, not Contacto-side.

Usage:
  plivo agent [command]

Available Commands:
  attach      Attach an agent to a Plivo application (rewrites answer/message/hangup URLs)
  create      Create a Vibe Agent — interactive on first call, resumable via -c on subsequent calls
  delete      Delete a Vibe Agent permanently (requires --yes)
  download    Download an agent's full config JSON (for inspection, diffing, version control)
  get         Get a single Vibe Agent by uuid
  list        List Vibe Agents on the active Contacto org
  publish     Promote a DRAFT agent to ACTIVE so the runner can serve it
  run         HTTP-trigger an agent flow (use this for outbound agents whose Start node has triggers: ["http"])
  session     Inspect or clear the saved vibe-agent create session (~/.plivo/vibe-session.json)
  update      Update an existing Vibe Agent (--from <workflow.json> or --name <new-name>)

Global Flags:
      --all                        auto-paginate through all pages
      --dry-run                    print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain                    explain what the command will do before executing
      --hodor-server plivo agent   base URL for hodor (used by plivo agent and `plivo auth token`)
      --log-level string           log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color                   disable colored output
  -o, --output string              output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string             named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet                      suppress non-data output
      --timeout int                request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                        skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo agent [command] --help" for more information about a command.
